persona: Senior automation tester who plans releases but has not yet led a team
resumeText:
Kavya Reddy | Hyderabad | kavya.reddy@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Senior QA Engineer, Banjara Health Systems, Hyderabad (2018 - present)
- Wrote the test strategy and test plan for each quarterly release of the patient app.
- Built a Selenium WebDriver framework in Java with 900 regression tests.
- Automate REST API checks with Postman and Rest Assured.
- Run defect triage calls with developers and log bugs in Jira.
- Take part in sprint planning and backlog grooming with the Scrum team.
- Present release quality reports to the product and engineering heads.
- Guide three junior testers on writing test cases.

QA Engineer, Charminar Softlabs, Hyderabad (2016 - 2018)
- Tested web forms and reports by hand against written test cases.

EDUCATION
BTech Electronics and Communication, JNTU Hyderabad, 2016

CERTIFICATIONS
ISTQB Certified Tester Foundation Level (2017)
